def signed_delta_pair(before, after):
    """Little formatting helper for a change-log I'm printing to the terminal.
    before and after are ints. The idea is one tidy string that shows the old
    value, the new value, and how far it moved, so a column of these reads at
    a glance. Return exactly '<before> -> <after> (<delta>)' where <delta> is
    after - before formatted with an explicit sign for positive values ('+3'),
    plain for negative ('-3'), and '0' with no sign when unchanged. That's the
    whole job — build the string and hand it back, nothing fancier.

    >>> signed_delta_pair(3, 3)
    '3 -> 3 (0)'
    >>> signed_delta_pair(1, 4)
    '1 -> 4 (+3)'
    """
